entities.name: Joseph Sunday Ajomo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Sunday Ajomo was a Nigerian clergyman and bishop for the Roman Catholic Diocese of Lokoja. He became ordained in 1962. He was appointed bishop in 1992. He died in 2004.
